description: Defines utility functions for converting proxy server representations to and from string formats, including PAC strings, non-standard URIs, and Apple-specific dictionary parsing.

methods.name: PacResultElementToProxyServer
methods.description: Converts a PAC result element string to a ProxyServer object.

methods.name: ProxyServerToPacResultElement
methods.description: Converts a ProxyServer object to its PAC string representation.

methods.name: ProxyUriToProxyServer
methods.description: Converts a non-standard URI string to a ProxyServer object, with a default scheme.

methods.name: ProxyServerToProxyUri
methods.description: Converts a ProxyServer object to its URI string representation.

methods.name: GetSchemeFromUriScheme
methods.description: Parses the proxy scheme from a URI scheme string.

methods.name: ProxyDictionaryToProxyServer
methods.description: Apple-specific utility to extract a ProxyServer from a CFDictionary.
